sources.seats_and_government: Not yet indexed in ParlGov (fly.dev mirror's Poland data stops at 2019). Sourced from Wikipedia infobox, cross-checked by summing to the 460-seat total.
sources.wikidata_ids: https://www.wikidata.org (searched individually per party via wbsearchentities/full-text search API)

note: Third Tusk cabinet (formed Dec 2023) = Civic Coalition + Third Way + The Left. 'Third Way' is an electoral alliance of Poland 2050 (Q100979832) and the Polish People's Party (Q218477); wikidata_id (Q118905408) is for the alliance itself, confirmed to exist as its own Wikidata item on a later pass. 'The Left' 2023 wikidata_id (Q107418166, 'New Left') is the Nowa Lewica party which led the Lewica electoral alliance; the 26 seats reported here are for the alliance as a whole, per the Wikipedia infobox convention, not New Left individually.
